cases.name: source_alias_unicode_crlf

document.text:
search marker="🙂" src=x
| eval alias=src | table alias

cases.expected_candidate_text:
search marker="🙂" actor=x
| eval alias=actor | table alias
cases.expected_text:
search marker="🙂" actor=x
| eval alias=actor | table alias
oracle_obligations: Only source reads change; explicit alias and downstream alias remain unchanged.
Original/candidate UTF-8 byte locations account for emoji, CRLF and longer replacement.
Unaffected bytes, source IDs, rule evidence and canonical identities remain exact.

| table alias
